subject: science
concept: Understanding momentum and impulse, and the conservation of momentum in collisions
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Forces and Motion) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student collides physical carts of different masses and measures resulting velocities to verify momentum conservation
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a collision scenario to its correctly calculated post-collision velocities
exercise.abstract: Student solves a momentum conservation problem for a given collision scenario

misconception_flags: applies conservation of momentum without accounting for the correct sign/direction of each object's velocity

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
